meta.name: Spa-Francorchamps
meta.scope: Elevated Spa circuit, pit lane, low kerbs, edge lines, gravel and runoff; scenery excluded; broad model-derived grass slopes and foundation

pitRoute.method: Longest native pit pavement strip adjacent to the start/finish; source direction follows the CSV

limitations: Road pieces are fitted rectangular blocks with small essential overlaps at bends.
The source pit route is smoothed and its connection is adapted to the widened racing road.
Kerbs and runoff use model material/colour cross-sections, with tiny texture fragments merged.
Stored byte/object limits cannot be inferred from the client export.
Roadside grass uses narrow fitted slope strips; open areas use broad planar patches and foundation tiles. Outer terraces and rectangular borders remain.
Spa pit entry/exit are adapted on the start straight. Scenic buildings, spectator furniture, trees and service roads are excluded. Vehicle handling requires in-game testing.

pitLayout.method: Native Spa modern pit strip, widened to 18 studs, with tangential entry/exit on the start straight

gradedSurface.method: Cyclic hinged world planes with matching full-width cross-sections
